first.rationale: I currently intend to test a shorter, lower-friction onboarding flow because onboarding completion is down 4% and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup requirements improved early adoption. A small guarded test is appropriate while verifying whether the historical lift translated into qualified long-term revenue rather than only activation proxies. I am not prioritizing promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because it may acquire lower-margin or less-qualified accounts.
